locations.label: Generator 1
locations.description: Activate all six generators by paying at the console and staying inside the capture area while fighting the Templar zombies. Their locations are Spawn (1), Tank Station (2), the other trench route (3), Jugger-Nog (4), Stamin-Up (5) and behind the Church (6). All six must be powered to use Pack-a-Punch at the top of Excavation. Retake generators when the Templar squad disables them. The overlay highlights the surrounding area, not a surveyed pickup point.

locations.label: Gramophone / excavation interior
locations.description: Pick up the gramophone beside the table inside Excavation. Find the black record around the mound: by the engine at the ramp, on the Church-facing low wall, or in the wheelbarrow by Pack-a-Punch. Place the gramophone on the Excavation table to open the spiral staircase, then retrieve it. The overlay highlights the surrounding area, not a surveyed pickup point.

locations.label: Lower Excavation staff pedestals
locations.description: With an element’s three pieces and crystal collected, use its pedestal at the bottom of Excavation to build that staff. Repeat for all four; a solo player can swap between staffs there. Building is only the first stage—each still needs its own elemental trial and the common charging step. The overlay highlights the surrounding area, not a surveyed pickup point.

locations.label: Tank Station stone tablet
locations.description: Take a stone tablet from the Tank Station table and put it in the upstairs Church basin. Earn nearby melee kills until the tablet is clean and the soul effect stops. Take it back to Tank Station without touching mud: follow the boards out of Church, around Excavation and through the Workshop to Generator 2. If it becomes dirty, wash it in the basin again and retry the walk. The overlay highlights the surrounding area, not a surveyed pickup point.
